reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that model accuracy hinges on quality of strength features rather than learner architecture. The Bradley-Terry model provides a principled way to encode pairwise preferences into latent strengths. By integrating dynamic adjustments such as park and defense effects, we enhance the fidelity of these features. Ensemble calibration ensures that even imperfect models contribute meaningfully to final predictions. This approach avoids premature reliance on complex learners like GNNs which lack sufficient data support, instead focusing on robust foundational elements. Failure modes include overfitting to idiosyncratic features or ignoring structural dependencies like home field advantage. The system must also guard against overconfidence in sparse data regimes, necessitating partial ordering and confidence caps.
